diag_intro: Hitamo ibimenyetso ubona mu ngurube zawe kugirango ugabanye indwara zishobora kubaho.
diag_no_matches: Ntamikino ikomeye iboneka ishingiye kubimenyetso byubu. Nyamuneka saba veterineri kugirango ugenzure neza.
dis_aflatoxicosis_desc: Uburozi bwuburozi buturuka ku ngano zumye cyangwa ibiryo bitera umwijima na jaundice.
dis_aflatoxicosis_prev: Irinde kugaburira ibiryo byoroshye, kubika ibinyampeke mugihe cyumye, kandi ukoreshe uburozi.
dis_anaplasmosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri yanduye itera amaraso make, umuriro, na jaundice.
dis_anaplasmosis_prev: Shyira mubikorwa gahunda yo kugenzura no kugenzura amatiku.
dis_anemia_desc: Bikunze kugaragara mu ngurube zo mu nzu nta byongeweho ibyuma.
dis_anthrax_desc: Indwara ikomeye ya bagiteri ishobora gufata abantu.
dis_asf_desc: Indwara yanduye cyane kandi yica yiganje muri Afrika yuburengerazuba. Nta rukingo rubaho.
dis_asf_prev: Gukumira umutekano muke no kugabanya uburyo bwo guhinga.
dis_babesiosis_desc: Amaraso yanduye parasite itera umuriro mwinshi, kubura amaraso, ninkari zijimye.
dis_babesiosis_prev: Kugenzura amatiku ukoresheje acariside kandi ukomeze amakaramu adafite ibimera.
dis_biotin_deficiency_desc: Kubura imirire bitera ibinono byacitse, ibikomere byuruhu, no gucumbagira.
dis_biotin_deficiency_prev: Ongeraho indyo hamwe na biotine kandi wirinde hasi ya beto itose.
dis_brucellosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera kunanirwa kubyara.
dis_bvdv_pig_desc: Indwara ya Bovine Virus Diarrhea kwandura kwandura inka, bigatera gukuramo inda.
dis_bvdv_pig_prev: Komeza ingurube zitandukanye ninka nintama, kandi ugabanye guhuza amoko.
dis_c_difficile_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri mu ngurube zikivuka itera impiswi y'amazi no kubyimba.
dis_c_difficile_prev: Sukura kandi wanduze amakaramu ya farrowing neza kandi urebe neza ko hakiri kare.
dis_cassava_poisoning_desc: Uburozi bwa Cyanide buturuka kumizi cyangwa imyumbati yatunganijwe neza.
dis_cassava_poisoning_prev: Kuramo, guteka, izuba-ryumye, cyangwa imyumbati ya ferment mbere yo kugaburira.
dis_clostridial_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera kwangirika gukabije.
dis_coccidiosis_desc: Indwara ya parasitike yibasira cyane cyane ingurube.
dis_cold_stress_desc: Gukonjesha umubiri cyane mu ngurube, bigatera guhinda umushyitsi no gupfa cyane.
dis_cold_stress_prev: Tanga amatara yubushyuhe, udusanduku twikaraga, kandi ukomeze ahantu hakeye kandi hatarimo umushinga.
dis_congenital_tremor_desc: Imiterere ya Neurologiya mu ngurube zikivuka zitera guhinda umushyitsi.
dis_congenital_tremor_prev: Irinde gukoresha amasohoro ava mu ngurube zanduye kandi ugabanye imbaraga zo kubiba mugihe cyo gutwita.
dis_csf_desc: Indwara zandura cyane virusi isa na ASF.
dis_csf_prev: Inkingo hamwe no kubungabunga umutekano muke.
dis_cysticercosis_desc: Intambwe nini ya tapeworm yabantu mumitsi yingurube.
dis_demodectic_mange_desc: Uruhu rwa microscopique mite itera ibibara binini na pustules.
dis_demodectic_mange_prev: Kunoza imirire yubushyo, gutandukanya ingurube zanduye, no gukoresha acariside.
dis_ear_biting_desc: Imyitwarire idasanzwe aho ingurube ziruma ugutwi kwa bagenzi bawe, bigatera necrosis.
dis_ear_biting_prev: Mugabanye imbaga, utezimbere umwuka, kandi utange ubutunzi nkumunyururu.
dis_ear_necrosis_desc: Akenshi biterwa no guhangayika, ubucucike bwinshi, cyangwa kwandura.
dis_ear_necrosis_prev: Mugabanye ubucucike no kuvura ubwandu bwa kabiri.
dis_edema_desc: Biterwa n'uburozi bwa E. coli mu ngurube zonsa.
dis_emcv_desc: Indwara iterwa na virusi itera kunanirwa k'umutima no gukuramo inda.
dis_emcv_prev: Shyira mu bikorwa igenzura rikomeye kandi urinde ibiryo kwanduza.
dis_endocarditis_desc: Indwara y'umutima itera kunanirwa k'umutima n'urupfu rutunguranye mugihe cy'amaganya.
dis_endocarditis_prev: Wihutire kuvura ingingo-zirwaye n'ibikomere, hanyuma uhitemo kurwanya genetiki yanduye.
dis_ergotism_desc: Uburozi bwibihumyo biva mu binyampeke byanduye ergot, bigatera tissue necrosis.
dis_ergotism_prev: Mugaburira ibiryo byumubiri kumubiri wijimye kandi usimbuze ibiryo byanduye.
dis_erysipelas_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ibikomere bitandukanye byuruhu na artrite.
dis_fascioliasis_desc: Indwara ya parasitike ifata umwijima, ikunze kugaragara mu rwuri rutose cyangwa ibishanga.
dis_fascioliasis_prev: Irinde ingurube kurisha ahantu h'ibishanga no kugenzura ibyondo.
dis_fmd_desc: Indwara ya virusi itera ibisebe ku munwa no ku birenge.
dis_foot_rot_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri yinjira mu gikomere, itera kubora no gucumbagira.
dis_foot_rot_prev: Gusana beto ikaze, komeza hasi, kandi ukoreshe ubwogero bwamaguru nibikenewe.
dis_gastric_torsion_desc: Kubyimba gutunguranye no kugoreka igifu, biganisha ku rupfu rwihuse.
dis_gastric_torsion_prev: Irinde kugaburira amafunguro manini nyuma yo kwiyiriza ubusa no kugabanya ibiryo bya buri munsi mo ibice.
dis_glassers_desc: Bitera gutwika ibibyimba bikikije umutima, ibihaha, ingingo.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_desc: Uburozi bwo kugaburira ibiryo bibisi cyangwa birenze urugero, bitera ibibazo byubuhumekero.
dis_gossypol_toxicity_prev: Mugabanye ifunguro ryimbuto mumirire kandi ukoreshe sulfate yicyuma kugirango ubuze gossypol.
dis_greasy_pig_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera uruhu rwamavuta.
dis_heat_stroke_desc: Ubushyuhe bukabije kubera guhumeka nabi cyangwa igicucu.
dis_hydatid_disease_desc: Indwara ya parasitike itera sisitemu yuzuye amazi mu ngingo.
dis_hydatid_disease_prev: Kwangiza imbwa zihinga kandi zikababuza kurya ingingo zingurube.
dis_hyostrongylosis_desc: Indwara yo mu gifu itera gastrite, kubura amaraso, no kugabanya ibiro.
dis_hyostrongylosis_prev: Kuzenguruka urwuri, komeza amazu yumutse, kandi ushyire mubikorwa gahunda yo kwangiza.
dis_ileitis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri yo mu mara mato.
dis_iron_toxicity_desc: Irashobora kubaho mugihe icyuma cyatewe muri Vit E ibuze ingurube.
dis_iron_toxicity_prev: Menya neza ko imirire yo kubiba iringaniye.
dis_leptospirosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri ya Zoonotic yibasira impyiko.
dis_listeriosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri ya sisitemu y'imitsi.
dis_mange_desc: Indwara y'uruhu rwa parasitike itera kubura amahwemo bikabije.
dis_melioidosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri ituruka ku butaka / amazi.
dis_mma_desc: Mastitis, metritis, na agalactia itera umuriro no kubura amata mu mbuto nyuma yo guhinga.
dis_mma_prev: Komeza kugira isuku yikaramu ikarishye kandi urebe neza imirire ihagije.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ingingo kubyimba, gucumbagira, no gucika intege.
dis_mycoplasma_arthritis_prev: Kunoza imiturire, kugabanya ubwinshi bwimigabane, no kuvura hakiri kare.
dis_navel_bleeding_desc: Amaraso menshi ava mumatongo mu ngurube zikivuka.
dis_navel_bleeding_prev: Ihambire umugozi ukivuka kandi wirinde kugaburira ibiryo byanduye mycotoxine kubiba.
dis_navel_ill_prev: Iyode yibiza mugihe cyo kuvuka no kugira isuku.
dis_necrotic_enteritis_desc: Indwara yuburozi bwa bagiteri itera impiswi ikabije yamaraso nimpfu nyinshi zingurube.
dis_necrotic_enteritis_prev: Gukingiza kubiba mbere yo guhunika no gukomeza isuku yikaramu yuzuye.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_desc: Parasite yo munda itera nodules mu rukuta rw'inda, biganisha ku mbuto zoroshye.
dis_oesophagostomiasis_prev: Isuku yamakaramu isanzwe no gukoresha bisanzwe anthemmintics.
dis_parakeratosis_desc: Indwara yintungamubiri itera igikomere gikabije, igikomere cyuruhu.
dis_parakeratosis_prev: Menya neza igipimo cya calcium-kuri-zinc mu biryo kandi utange inyongera ya zinc.
dis_ped_desc: Bisa na TGE, byica cyane kuri neonates.
dis_phe_desc: Impiswi ikabije yamaraso nimpfu zitunguranye mubuhinzi / barangiza ingurube.
dis_phe_prev: Komeza kugira isuku nziza kandi ukoreshe antibiyotike ikwiye iyobowe nubuvuzi.
dis_photosensitization_desc: Gukomera kwizuba nkingurube zifite uruhu rworoshye nyuma yo kurya ibimera byihariye.
dis_photosensitization_prev: Tanga igicucu, ukureho ibyatsi bibi, kandi ugumane ingurube mu nzu.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_desc: Imiterere yuruhu itanduye mu ngurube zikiri nto zikora impeta.
dis_pityriasis_rosea_prev: Mubisanzwe kwikemurira ibibazo; komeza ibitanda bisukuye, byumye kandi bigabanye imihangayiko.
dis_pneumonia_desc: Indwara zubuhumekero zidakira zitera gukura nabi.
dis_polyserositis_desc: Fibrinous inflammation yibihaha, umutima, hamwe nubuso bufatanye mubonsa.
dis_polyserositis_prev: Mugabanye guhangayika, wirinde kuvanga imyanda, kandi uhumeke neza.
dis_pox_desc: Indwara y'uruhu rwa virusi, ikwirakwizwa n'indwara.
dis_ppv_desc: Impamvu zisanzwe zitera kunanirwa kwimyororokere muri gilts.
dis_prdc_desc: Indwara zifata imyanya y'ubuhumekero ya virusi na bagiteri itera inkorora no gukura nabi.
dis_prdc_prev: Kunoza umwuka, irinde ubucucike, kandi ugenzure virusi yibanze.
dis_pseudorabies_desc: Indwara ya virusi yibasira sisitemu y'imitsi n'ubuhumekero.
dis_pseudorabies_prev: Gahunda yo gukingira no kurandura burundu.
dis_pss_desc: Imiterere ya genetike iterwa no guhangayika.
dis_pwd_desc: Impiswi ya bagiteri mu ngurube nyuma gato yo konka, itera umwuma.
dis_pwd_prev: Mugabanye guhagarika umutima, kubungabunga isuku nyinshi, no gutanga amazi meza yo kunywa.
dis_rabies_desc: Indwara yica virusi mubisanzwe ituruka kurumwa.
dis_rectal_prolapse_desc: Akenshi ikurikira inkorora, impiswi, cyangwa imihangayiko ikonje.
dis_rickets_desc: Kubura imirire bigira ingaruka kumikurire yamagufwa.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_desc: Indwara ikabije yamaraso salmonella itera uruhu rwumutuku nurupfu rwihuse.
dis_salmonella_septicemia_prev: Gutandukanya ingurube zirwaye, kuvura amazi, no kubungabunga umutekano muke.
dis_salmonellosis_desc: Indwara ya bagiteri itera ibibazo bikomeye byo munda.
dis_salt_poisoning_desc: Biterwa no kubura amazi bikurikirwa no kunywa cyane.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_desc: Ibisebe byumuvuduko ku bitugu byimbuto zoroshye zubatswe kuri beto ikomeye.
dis_shoulder_ulcers_prev: Tanga uburiri bworoshye, komeza kubiba mumubiri mwiza, kandi ukoreshe materi.
dis_sow_hysteria_desc: Imyitwarire idahwitse aho kubiba bigatera ubukana no kuruma ingurube.
dis_sow_hysteria_prev: Tanga ahantu hatuje hatuje, ugenzure gilts, kandi ukoreshe imiti igabanya ubukana.
dis_spirochetal_colitis_desc: Indwara y'impiswi yoroheje mu gukura ingurube, itera kwiyongera nabi.
dis_spirochetal_colitis_prev: Sukura inkono zigaburira kandi uvure ingurube zanduye hamwe na antibiotike.
dis_splayleg_desc: Ingurube zavutse zidashobora kwihagararaho n'amaguru y'inyuma.
dis_strongyloidiasis_desc: Inzoka zo munda zitera impiswi zikomeye nimpfu zingurube.
dis_strongyloidiasis_prev: Komeza ibisanduku byumye byumye kandi bisukuye, kandi imbuto zinzoka mbere yo guhinga.
dis_sunburn_desc: Ifata ingurube zifite uruhu rwera hanze.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_desc: Uburozi buturuka ku birayi biryoshye, bitera uburwayi bukomeye bwo guhumeka.
dis_sweet_potato_toxicity_prev: Kureka ibirayi byangiritse cyangwa byumye; kugaburira ibirayi gusa.
dis_tetanus_desc: Uburozi bwa bagiteri bugira ingaruka kuri sisitemu y'imitsi.
dis_tge_desc: Indwara ya virusi hamwe nimpfu nyinshi mu ngurube zikiri nto.
dis_thorny_headed_worm_desc: Inyo ya parasitike yabonetse mukurya inyenzi, bigatera gutobora amara.
dis_thorny_headed_worm_prev: Irinde kurera kubuntu kubutaka bwatewe ninyenzi kandi ukoreshe ibyatsi.
dis_trichinellosis_desc: Indwara ya parasitike ya Zoonotic ituruka ku kurya inyama mbisi, bigatuma imitsi ikomera.
dis_trichinellosis_prev: Ntugaburire ibishishwa bibisi, guteka ibiryo by'iminota 30, no kugenzura imbeba.
dis_trypanosomiasis_desc: Indwara ya Protozoan ikwirakwizwa nisazi ya tsetse.
dis_ulcers_desc: Biterwa no kugaburira neza cyangwa guhangayika.
dis_vs_prev: Kurwanya udukoko no gushyira mu kato.
dis_vulvovaginitis_desc: Biterwa n'uburozi bwa estrogeneque fungal mu biryo.

guide_breeding_step1_desc: Shakisha reflex ihagaze, kubyimba kubyimba, hamwe nijwi. Andika serivisi karemano cyangwa AI hamwe nibisobanuro birambuye.
guide_breeding_step1_tip: Imyitozo myiza ni ugukorera imbuto kabiri: amasaha 12 atandukanye mugihe cy'ubushyuhe buhagaze.
guide_breeding_step2_desc: SmartSwine ihita iteganya gusubiramo ubushyuhe muminsi 18-24 no kumenyesha kure iminsi 110-114.
guide_breeding_step2_tip: Reba gusubira mu bushyuhe hafi yumunsi wa 21. Niba kubiba byerekana ubushyuhe buhagaze, ongera ukore ako kanya.
guide_breeding_step3_desc: Kurandura ibisanduku bya farrowing hanyuma wimure imbuto zitwite iminsi 4 kugeza 5 mbere yigihe giteganijwe. Tegura amatara yubushyuhe yingurube.
guide_breeding_step3_tip: Komeza ahantu h'ingurube hashyushye (30-32 ° C) kugirango wirinde hypothermia kubana bavutse.
guide_breeding_step4_desc: Log Yavutse ari muzima, Abana bavutse, Mummies, hamwe nuburemere bwuzuye bwo kuvuka kugirango dusuzume imbuto zababyeyi.
guide_breeding_step4_tip: Koresha inshinge zicyuma no gukuramo amenyo y'urushinge mumasaha 24-48 uhereye kure.
guide_breeding_subtitle: Kurikirana kubiba ubushyuhe, gutanga amatariki, gusama iminsi 114, hamwe na litiro.
guide_feed_step1_desc: Jya kuri 'Kugaburira' hanyuma ufungure igikoresho cya 'Kugaburira ibiryo' kugirango ukore cyangwa uhindure ibiryo byagabanijwe.
guide_feed_step1_tip: Reba ibiciro byisoko ryibanze mbere kugirango umenye proteine ​​zihenze cyane nisoko ryingufu.
guide_feed_step2_desc: Hitamo intego y'ingurube (Creep, Starter, Grower, Finisher, Gestating Sow, Lactating Sow) kugirango ushiremo intungamubiri zisanzwe.
guide_feed_step2_tip: Ingurube zikura zisaba proteine nyinshi (16-18%) kuruta gutera inda (12-14%).
guide_feed_step3_desc: Ongeramo ibirungo nkibigori, Ifunguro rya Soya, Ingano yingano, Fishmeal, na Premix. Kuringaniza ijanisha kugeza utubari twintungamubiri duhindutse icyatsi.
guide_feed_step3_tip: Menya neza ko Kalisiyumu igereranije na Fosifore (Ca: P) iguma hagati ya 1.2: 1 na 1.6: 1 kugirango amagufwa akure neza.
guide_feed_step4_desc: Bika uburyo bwawe bwuzuye kugirango ubone uburyo bwihuse, cyangwa wandike icyiciro kivanze kugirango uhite uvugurura ibiryo.
guide_feed_step4_tip: Kuvanga ibiryo mubice bimwe hanyuma ubike muri pallet yumye, hejuru kugirango wirinde aflatoxine no kwangirika.
guide_feed_subtitle: Shushanya ibiciro-byuzuye, byuzuye byuzuye indyo yuzuye kuri buri cyiciro.
guide_finances_step1_desc: Andika amafaranga yose yakoreshejwe mu murima ashyirwa mu byiciro na Feed, Veterinari, Umurimo, Ibikorwa, no Kubungabunga.
guide_finances_step1_tip: Andika amafaranga akimara kugura bibaye bityo gusesengura ibiciro bigume bigezweho.
guide_finances_step2_desc: Andika amafaranga avuye kugurisha amatungo mazima, imirambo yabagiwe, ubworozi, cyangwa ifumbire mvaruganda.
guide_finances_step2_tip: Andika uburemere bwuzuye nigiciro cyanyuma kuri kg kugirango ukurikirane isoko ryagaragaye.
guide_finances_step3_desc: Ongera usuzume COP kuri kg hamwe na Finisher Breakeven igiciro kugirango buri gikorwa gitange inyungu nziza.
guide_finances_step3_tip: Ibiryo bigomba kwerekana neza 65-75% yikiguzi cyawe cyose. Mugabanye gusesagura ibiryo.
guide_finances_subtitle: Kurikirana amafaranga yakoreshejwe, kugurisha, no kubara ikiguzi cy'umusaruro kuri kg.
guide_health_step1_desc: Koresha igikoresho cyo gushakisha indwara kugirango uhuze ibimenyetso byubuvuzi byagaragaye (inkorora, impiswi, ibikomere) hamwe ningurube zisanzwe.
guide_health_step1_tip: Tandukanya inyamaswa zirwaye ako kanya mu kiraro cya karantine mbere yo gutangira kuvurwa.
guide_health_step2_desc: Andika imiti ya antibiotique cyangwa antiparasitike kandi wandike neza iminsi yo gukuramo inyama.
guide_health_step2_tip: Ntuzigere ucuruza cyangwa kubaga itungo mbere yuko idirishya ryuzuye ryo gukuramo inyama rirangira.
guide_health_step3_desc: Komeza ibyogero byamaguru hamwe na disinfectant, kugenzura abasura imirima, gusukura ibinyabiziga, no guha akato ibigega bishya muminsi 30.
guide_health_step3_tip: Biosecurity ihendutse inshuro 10 kuruta kuvura icyorezo cyindwara.
guide_health_subtitle: Menya ibimenyetso, ukurikize protocole yubuvuzi, kandi ukomeze umutekano muke.
guide_herd_step1_desc: Injira 'Ubushyo bwamakuru' uhereye kumurongo wibanze cyangwa ibishushanyo kugirango urebe ibyanditswe byose byubushyo.
guide_herd_step1_tip: Urashobora gushungura inyandiko zubushyo kumiterere (Igikorwa, Igurishwa, Cull) ukoresheje imiterere ya tabs.
guide_herd_step2_desc: Kanda buto '+' ireremba. Uzuza amakuru y'ingenzi: Ikirangantego, Ubwoko, Igitsina, Itariki y'amavuko, n'ikaramu.
guide_herd_step2_tip: Shinga indangamuntu zisobanutse, zisanzwe (urugero, SOW-001, BOAR-01) kugirango byoroshye gukurikirana umurima.
guide_herd_step3_desc: Fungura ikarita yerekana umwirondoro winyamanswa kugirango wandike ibipimo bisanzwe, inkingo, kurwara, cyangwa kwivuza.
guide_herd_step3_tip: Gupima bisanzwe bifasha kubara neza Impuzandengo Yunguka ya buri munsi (ADG) no kumenya indwara hakiri kare.
guide_herd_step4_desc: Itsinda rikura ingurube mu makaramu yagenewe cyangwa mu matsinda kugira ngo ukurikirane neza ubwinshi bw'ikaramu no kugaburira ibiryo.
guide_herd_step4_tip: Irinde amakaramu yuzuye kugira ngo wirinde imyitwarire yo kuruma kandi urebe neza ko inyamaswa zikura.
guide_herd_subtitle: Andika inyamaswa, ucunge amatwi, utange amakaramu, kandi ukurikirane umurongo.
guide_hr_step1_desc: Iyandikishe abakozi, abashinzwe imirima, hamwe nabaveterineri bafite uruhushya rwihariye rwo kwinjira.
guide_hr_step1_tip: Kubuza uburyo bwamafaranga kubayobozi naba bayobozi bikomeza inyandiko zumutekano.
guide_hr_step2_desc: Tanga gahunda za buri munsi nko kugaburira ikaramu, gusukura amazi, amasaha ya kure, no kumenya ubushyuhe.
guide_hr_step2_tip: Kugenzura urutonde rwibikorwa birinda ibiryo byabuze cyangwa gutinda kumiti.
guide_hr_step3_desc: Andika umushahara, ibihembo, hamwe nogukata kugirango ukomeze amateka yimishahara iboneye.
guide_hr_step3_tip: Buri gihe shyiramo inyandiko zerekana ibihembo cyangwa avansi yimishahara kugirango igenzurwe neza.
guide_hr_subtitle: Gucunga abakozi, kugenera imirimo ya buri munsi, gukurikirana abitabira, no guhemba umushahara.
guide_intro_desc: Intambwe ku yindi ibikorwa byoguhuza ibikorwa kugirango byorohereze ubuzima bwubushyo, kugaburira ibiryo, ukwezi kwororoka, imari, no gucunga abakozi.

tip_15_content: Menya neza ko ingurube zose zishobora kurya icyarimwe mugutanga inkono ndende, ntoya cyangwa ibiti bya beto (hafi 15-20cm yumwanya winkono kuri buri ngurube).
tip_16_content: Kumanika igitoki kibisi kibisi mu ikaramu yonsa. Ingurube zirahekenya, zituma zitwarwa kandi zikarinda umurizo.
tip_17_content: Shira isuka isukuye yubutaka bushya, butukura bwibumba (uhereye ahantu hasukuye) mukaramu ya kure / yonsa. Ingurube zirarya kugirango zibone fer na minerval.
tip_18_content: Shira inkono y'amazi cyangwa abanywa ibinyobwa buke bihagije (uburebure-bwinyuma bwingurube ntoya) kugirango ingurube zose zonsa zishobora kunywa byoroshye.
tip_19_content: Fungura igabana hagati yamakaramu abiri yicyumweru mbere yicyumweru mbere yo konka kugirango ingurube zisabane, bigabanye imirwano iyo bishyize hamwe nyuma.
tip_1_content: Ibiryo byiza cyane ni ngombwa. Menya neza ko ingurube zifite amazi meza hamwe nimirire yuzuye ikwiranye niterambere ryayo.
tip_20_content: Guteka ibikomoka ku buhinzi nkibishishwa bya yam, ibishishwa by imyumbati, nimizabibu y ibirayi kugirango wangize uburozi karemano kandi bitezimbere.
tip_21_content: Ongeraho ibiryo byubucuruzi ukura ibihingwa bya poroteyine nyinshi nka Moringa, Azolla, cyangwa ibibabi byibijumba kumurima.
tip_22_content: Gabanya imbuto zo gutwita kugeza kuri kg 2-2.5 y'ibiryo kumunsi kugirango wirinde kubyibuha birenze urugero, bitera kubyara bigoye.
tip_23_content: Kuvanga isoko ya fibre ihendutse nka bran yumuceri, ingano, cyangwa ifunguro rya copra mubiryo byo gusama kugirango bibe byuzuye kandi bituje.
tip_24_content: Koresha ingunguru ya pulasitiki itunganijwe cyangwa ingoma zashyizwemo ibinyobwa byonsa nka sisitemu y'amazi ahendutse kandi meza ku makaramu y'ingurube.
tip_25_content: Bika imifuka yo kugaburira kuri palette yimbaho hasi ya beto kandi kure yinkuta kugirango wirinde gukura no gukura.
tip_26_content: Guteka amahoteri cyangwa ibiryo byo mu gikoni muminota 30 kugirango wangize virusi yingurube nyafurika hamwe na virusi yindwara yamaguru-Umunwa.
tip_27_content: Koresha ibinyobwa bisembuye nk'ibiryo bihendutse, ariko bigabanye 30-40% bya ration hanyuma ubigaburire bishya kugirango wirinde uburozi.
tip_28_content: Shira ibice bito by'amakara mu makaramu y'abahinzi. Ingurube zirahekenya kugirango zifashe guhuza uburozi bwigifu no kugabanya impiswi.
tip_29_content: Kugaburira amashereka abiba amafunguro mato 3 kugeza kuri 4 umunsi wose (aho kurya ifunguro rimwe) kugirango ubashishikarize kurya byinshi no gutanga amata menshi.
tip_2_content: Umutekano w’ibinyabuzima ni ingenzi. Gabanya abashyitsi, utange ibirenge, kandi ukomeze gahunda ihamye yo gukingira hamwe na veterineri wawe.
tip_30_content: Mugihe uvanga ibiryo kumurima, vanga mikorobe (vitamine, umunyu, imyunyu ngugu) mugice gito cyibigori mbere yo kuvanga ikirundo kinini.
tip_31_content: Gabanya Leucaena (ipil-ipil) ifunguro ryibabi kugeza munsi ya 5% yibiryo, kuko birimo mimosine ishobora gutera umusatsi no kunanirwa kwimyororokere.
tip_32_content: Kugaburira imbuto zoroshye cyane ibiryo mugihe cyo gutwita, kandi ugabanye ibiryo kubibinure kugirango umubiri ugire ubuzima bwiza.
tip_33_content: Isuku yo kunywa buri munsi. Niba amazi asa nkaho yanduye cyangwa akunuka nabi, ntabwo ari umutekano ku ngurube zawe.
tip_34_content: Zana imbuto mu bushyuhe ku ikaramu y'ingurube kugira ngo yororoke, aho kureka ingurube ikagenda mu bushyo bw'imbuto.
tip_35_content: Gerageza ubushyuhe ukanda amaboko yawe kumugongo wimbuto; niba ahagaze rwose kandi akomanga amatwi, yiteguye kurambagiza.
tip_36_content: Kuramo amakaramu ya farow hamwe nuruvange rwa lime yubuhinzi namazi (kwera) kugirango yanduze urukuta hasi hasi.
tip_37_content: Kuma ingurube zumye vuba uhite ukoresha imifuka isukuye, yumye cyangwa imyenda kugirango wirinde gukonja n'indwara z'ubuhumekero.
tip_38_content: Niba inshinge zicyuma zitaboneka, koresha igitaka gisukuye hamwe na paste-sulfate yicyayi ku mbuto zimbuto buri munsi kugirango ingurube zifata ibyuma mugihe wonsa.
tip_3_content: Komeza ingurube zivutse kandi urebe ko zakira colostrum mumasaha yambere yo kuvuka kugirango wubake ubudahangarwa.
tip_40_content: Koresha agasanduku koroheje k'ibiti gafite itara rito cyangwa uburiri bushyushye (nk'ibyatsi byumye) kugirango ingurube zishyushye ahantu h'ibisimba.
tip_41_content: Koza amabere y'imbuto hamwe n'icyayi ukoresheje amazi ashyushye hamwe na disinfectant yoroheje mbere yuko yanga kurinda ingurube zikivuka.
tip_42_content: Intoki-zigaragaza intoki ziva mu cyayi cy'imbuto hanyuma ukagaburira ingurube zifite intege nke ukoresheje siringi cyangwa ikiyiko.
tip_43_content: Shyira amatariki yo kororoka kuri kalendari; gutwita bimara iminsi 114 (amezi 3, ibyumweru 3, iminsi 3), bikwemerera gutegura ikaramu ya farrow.
tip_44_content: Komeza gusimbuza gilts kubabyeyi bafite ubunini bunini, kubyara amata meza, hamwe no gutuza kwababyeyi.
tip_45_content: Genda ingurube ikuze unyuze hejuru yikaramu ya gilt kugirango ubashishikarize kuza mubushyuhe hakiri kare kandi werekane ibimenyetso byubushyuhe.
tip_46_content: Shira indobo y'amazi meza hafi yumutwe wimbuto kugirango abashe kunywa atabyutse.
tip_47_content: Rindira gushika byibuze amezi 8 no kumurongo wa kabiri cyangwa wa gatatu w'ubushyuhe mbere yo kumuhuza kugirango umenye imyanda nini ya mbere.
tip_48_content: Bika ingurube nshya zaguzwe mu ikaramu yihariye byibura metero 20 uvuye mu bushyo bwawe bwiminsi 30 kugirango urebe niba urwaye.
tip_49_content: Shira igikarabiro kitagabanije cyangwa ipine yaciwemo igice cyuzuye amazi na disinfectant (nka chlorine cyangwa lime yubuhinzi) ku irembo ry umurima.
tip_4_content: Gufata neza ifumbire birinda impumuro n'indwara. Tekereza ifumbire cyangwa gukoresha imyanda nk'ifumbire y'ibihingwa.
tip_50_content: Gumana abahinzi, abarangiza, n'imbuto zororoka mu makaramu atandukanye kugirango wirinde ingurube zikuze kwanduza indwara zidakira ku bato.
tip_51_content: Ntukemere abashyitsi (cyane cyane abandi baguzi b'ingurube cyangwa abahinzi) imbere mu kiraro cyawe cy'ingurube. Muganire kubucuruzi hanze yikaramu.
tip_52_content: Wubake uruzitiro rworoshye (ukoresheje imigano, ibiti, cyangwa insinga z'insinga) uzengurutse ingurube kugirango wirinde imbwa zizerera, ingurube zo mu gasozi, n'abaturanyi.
tip_53_content: Bika inshinge zikoreshwa mu icupa rya plastike rifunze cyangwa mu kintu mbere yo gushyingura cyangwa kujugunya neza kugirango wirinde impanuka.
tip_54_content: Ntuzigere wemerera abaguzi b'ingurube gutwara amakamyo yabo hafi y'amakaramu y'ingurube. Umutwaro wagurishijwe ingurube ku irembo ryumurima cyangwa uruzitiro rwa perimetero.
tip_55_content: Kugaburira imbuto za papayi zimenetse cyangwa imbuto y'ibihaza kugirango uhingure ingurube nk'umuti uhendutse, usanzwe ufasha kugabanya inyo zo munda.
tip_56_content: Niba umurizo ufata, wandike igikoresho cyo gukata mumazi abira cyangwa inzoga hagati yingurube kugirango wirinde kwandura.
tip_57_content: Sukura kandi utere amakaramu y'ingurube buri cyumweru hamwe n'umuti uhendutse, wangiza udukoko twangiza, urebe ko ingurube zimuka cyangwa amagorofa akuma vuba.
tip_58_content: Menya neza ko amashyo yawe y’inkumbi yakingiwe kandi akanayanduza buri gihe, kuko ashobora gukwirakwiza indwara ku mbuto zose zororoka.
tip_59_content: Shira ku ruhande ikaramu imwe yonyine, yumye, ishyushye kuruhande rwumurima kugirango uvure ingurube zirwaye kure yubushyo bwiza.
tip_5_content: Kurikirana iterambere, ubuzima, n’imari witonze kugirango umenye imigendekere no kuzamura inyungu zubuhinzi.
tip_60_content: Gushyingura ingurube zapfuye byibura metero 2 zubujyakuzimu, kure y’amasoko y’amazi, hanyuma utwikire umurambo nindimu yubuhinzi mbere yo kuzuza ubutaka.
tip_61_content: Tanga byibuze metero kare 1 kuri buri ngurube irangiza kugirango ugabanye imirwano, imihangayiko, hamwe nindwara zuruhu.
tip_62_content: Shushanya amazu yingurube afite impande zifunguye (ukoresheje inshundura cyangwa imigano) kugirango umuyaga usanzwe uhuhuta kandi ukureho impumuro.
tip_63_content: Shushanya ibisenge by'icyuma ukoresheje irangi ryera cyangwa ubitwikire amababi y'imikindo cyangwa igikoma kugirango ugabanye ubushyuhe mu nzu y'ingurube mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe.
tip_64_content: Mugihe ushyira hasi hasi, shushanya hejuru hamwe na sima kugirango ukore uduce duto kugirango ingurube zitanyerera kandi zikomeretsa amaguru.
tip_65_content: Koresha ibiti byumye cyangwa ibiti byumye hasi hasi kugirango ushiremo ubuhehere, kugumisha ingurube no kugabanya imirimo yo gukora isuku.
tip_66_content: Sukura ifumbire mu makaramu buri munsi. Urwego rwa gaze ya amoniya (rwerekanwa n'amaso yaka cyangwa impumuro ikomeye) rushobora kwangiza ibihaha by'ingurube.
tip_67_content: Ku ngurube zabitswe hanze cyangwa mu kiraro cyanduye, tanga urukuta rw'igicucu kugira ngo rubafashe gukonja mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe.
tip_68_content: Koza kandi usukure ibiryo by'ibiti cyangwa beto buri cyumweru kugirango wirinde ibiryo bitoshye bitera igifu.
tip_69_content: Manika amacupa ya plastike yuzuyemo amabuye mato cyangwa amapine ya reberi mu ikaramu kugirango uhe ingurube ikintu cyo gukina, kugabanya imirwano.
tip_6_content: Kwonsa ingurube muminsi 28 kugeza 35 aho kuba kare. Ibi bituma ingurube zikomera kandi zikamenyera ibiryo bikomeye ukoresheje umutungo woroshye wo guhinga.
tip_70_content: Tera ibiti byamababi kuruhande rwiburasirazuba nuburengerazuba bwinzu yingurube kugirango utange igicucu gisanzwe kandi uhagarike izuba rishyushye.
tip_71_content: Kumanura hasi ya beto gato (hafi 2-3%) werekeza kumuyoboro wamazi kugirango ahantu ho kuruhukira hagume humye mugihe ahantu hacukuwe hatose.
tip_72_content: Tanga amakaramu yo gusama cyangwa ibice ukoresheje ibiti bikomeye byaho kugirango urinde imbuto zitwite gutotezwa nabandi.
tip_73_content: Koresha amababi ya cocout, amababi yimikindo, cyangwa ibyatsi byatsi munsi yinzu hejuru yicyuma nkuburyo buhendutse bwo kubika inyubako.
tip_74_content: Koresha imigano igabanijwe cyangwa ibiti bikozwe mu giti bifatanye n'insinga nk'ibikoresho bikomeye, bihenze byo kuzitira ingurube zo hanze.
tip_75_content: Kurunda ifumbire y'ingurube mu nguni yabugenewe yumye, uyitwikire amababi y'ibitoki cyangwa plastike, hanyuma ubihindure buri cyumweru ukoresheje amasuka kugirango ukore ifumbire.
tip_76_content: Shyiramo ibintu byoroshye, bidahenze bya pulasitike tubular biogas digester kugirango uvure ifumbire yingurube, utange gaze yo guteka kubuntu murugo.
tip_77_content: Kusanya amazi mabi avuye gukaraba ikaramu mu rwobo rwo kubikamo, kuyungurura amazi meza, hanyuma uyakoreshe mu kuvomera ibitoki cyangwa ibihingwa.
tip_78_content: Gukwirakwiza igiti cyumye ku miyoboro y'ifumbire kugirango ushire impumuro kandi wumishe imyanda, byoroshye gusuka.
tip_79_content: Shyiramo imyanda yoroshye (ukoresheje imigano igabanijwemo kabiri cyangwa imiyoboro ya PVC ihendutse) kugirango uyobore amazi yimvura kure yibyobo byamakaramu.
tip_7_content: Mugabanye guhangayikishwa no gukuramo imbuto mu ikaramu ya kure kandi usige ingurube aho zimenyereye icyumweru cya mbere.
tip_80_content: Niba gushyingura bidashoboka, wubake isanduku yoroshye ifumbire ukoresheje pallet yimbaho kugirango ifumbire yingurube zapfuye mumashanyarazi yumye.
tip_81_content: Kubaka agasanduku gato ko guturamo mu muyoboro w’amazi kugirango ufate ifumbire ikomeye mbere yuko amazi y’amazi yinjira mu cyuzi cyangwa mu busitani.
tip_82_content: Tera ibihuru cyangwa ibiti bikura vuba (nk'ibitoki cyangwa indimu) bikikije ingurube kugirango uhagarike umuyaga kandi ugabanye impumuro.
tip_83_content: Kubaka ikibanza cyoroshye cyazamutse cyibiti cyangwa beto kugirango ifumbire yizuba yumye mbere yo kuyipakira mumifuka igurishwa nkifumbire.
tip_84_content: Kuraho imiyoboro y'amazi buri munsi ukoresheje scraper yoroshye kugirango wirinde amazi adahagarara, ubworozi bw imibu, numunuko mubi.
tip_85_content: Umufatanyabikorwa hamwe n’abahinzi b’imboga cyangwa abahinzi hafi yo guhana ifumbire y’ingurube imyanda y’ibihingwa, ibyatsi, cyangwa umusaruro w’ibinyampeke.
tip_86_content: Gukwirakwiza ifumbire y'ingurube ifumbire mu butaka bw'ibihingwa byibura ibyumweru 2 mbere yo gutera, aho guhinga imboga.
tip_87_content: Gumana ibirundo byo kubika ifumbire itwikiriwe na tarpaulin cyangwa igisenge cyatsi kugirango wirinde imvura yoza intungamubiri z ibihingwa bifite agaciro.
tip_88_content: Koresha kare kare ya pande cyangwa plastike (gutondekanya ikibaho) kugirango uyobore kandi wimure ingurube witonze, aho gukoresha inkoni.
tip_89_content: Genda gahoro gahoro mu kiraro buri gitondo nimugoroba. Reba niba ingurube zose zihagaze, zirakora, kandi usa nushishikajwe no kugaburira.
tip_8_content: Hagarika umuyaga ukonje mu ikaramu y'incuke ushyiraho umwenda w'agateganyo cyangwa imbaho z'ibiti kugeza ku burebure bw'ingurube (hafi 50cm).
tip_90_content: Koresha igikoresho cyoroshye cya V-notch kugirango wandike amatwi yingurube kugirango umenye, wanduze igikoresho muri alcool nyuma ya buri ngurube.
tip_91_content: Gereranya uburemere bw'ingurube ukoresheje igipimo cyoroshye cyo kudoda (gupima ubukana bw'umutima n'uburebure, hanyuma ubare uburemere) niba umunzani uhenze cyane.
tip_92_content: Kata ingurube zabagabo mbere yiminsi 7. Kuri iyi myaka, inzira irihuta, ikira vuba, kandi itera ububabare buke.
tip_93_content: Himura ingurube ku isoko mugitondo cya nimugoroba cyangwa nimugoroba iyo bikonje, kandi ugicucu ibinyabiziga bitwara amababi ya cocout.
tip_94_content: Bika ikaye ntoya, ihendutse mu kiraro kugirango wandike amatariki yo kororoka, amatariki yo gukuramo, hamwe nubuvuzi kuri buri mbuto.
tip_95_content: Andika amategeko yoroshye yumurima ya buri munsi (nko gukaraba intoki, koza inkono, kugenzura amazi) kurubaho hafi yubwinjiriro bwikigega.
tip_96_content: Igisha abana cyangwa abafasha kumurima gufata neza ingurube, wirinde gukubita cyangwa gukurura umurizo, bigatuma ingurube zishyamba kandi biteje akaga.
tip_97_content: Bika ibiryo mu ndobo za pulasitike zifunze cyangwa ingoma zamavuta kugirango wirinde gukurura imbeba, imbeba, ninzoka mu murima.
tip_98_content: Reba abanywa amazi kabiri kumunsi uyakanda nurutoki kugirango umenye neza ko amazi atemba kandi adafunze umwanda.
tip_99_content: Imbuto zica zananiwe gusama nyuma yo kugerageza kororoka kabiri hamwe ningurube yemejwe, cyangwa izifite imyanda mito (munsi yingurube 6).
tos_acceptance_content: Mugihe winjiye kandi ukoresheje porogaramu ya SmartSwine, wemera kugengwa naya Masezerano ya serivisi. Niba utemera aya magambo, nyamuneka ntukoreshe serivisi.
tos_availability_content: Duharanira umwanya wa 99% ariko ntitwemeza ko serivisi zidahagarara. Ububiko bwamakuru butangwa nkuburyo bworoshye; ariko, abakoresha barashishikarizwa kubika inyandiko zabo.
tos_changes_content: Dufite uburenganzira bwo guhindura aya magambo igihe icyo aricyo cyose. Gukomeza gukoresha porogaramu ni ukwemera amagambo mashya.
tos_contact_content: Kubufasha cyangwa ibibazo byemewe n'amategeko, nyamuneka hamagara uwatezimbere ukoresheje igenamiterere rya porogaramu.
tos_data_privacy_content:
Ugumana nyirubwite amakuru winjije (amakuru yubusho, imari, e.t.c.). 
Amakuru yumurima wawe abitswe neza ukoresheje Google Firebase, mugihe duharanira kurinda amakuru yawe, ntidushobora kwemeza umutekano wuzuye. 
Mugushoboza Cloud Backup, wemera kubika no guhuza amakuru yawe mubikoresho byawe. 
Ntabwo tugurisha amakuru yawe bwite cyangwa umurima kubandi bantu.
Ushinzwe kumenya ukuri kwamakuru yinjiye. Amakuru atariyo muri "Kugaburira" cyangwa "Amafaranga" arashobora kuvamo kubara nabi.
tos_description_content:
"SmartSwine" itanga ibikoresho byo gucunga imirima harimo, ariko ntibigarukira gusa:
• Gukurikirana amashyo hamwe namakuru yubuzima.
Kubika amafaranga.
Gucunga abakozi.
• Ibitekerezo byo gusuzuma bifashwa na AI.
• Amakuru yo kubona isoko.
tos_financial_data_content: Module "Financials" nigikoresho cyo gukurikirana kandi ntabwo igizwe numucungamari wumwuga cyangwa inama zumusoro. Abakoresha barashishikarizwa kohereza amakuru yabo kugirango basuzumwe nabacungamari bemewe.
tos_liability_content: Porogaramu ya SmartSwine itangwa "nkuko biri." Ku rugero ntarengwa rwemewe n’amategeko, abayitezimbere ntibashobora kuryozwa ibyangiritse bitaziguye, bitaziguye, ibyabaye, cyangwa ingaruka zatewe no gukoresha cyangwa kudashobora gukoresha serivisi, harimo gutakaza amatungo cyangwa kunyuranya n’amafaranga.
tos_no_medical_content:
Ibiranga "Kugaburira Kugaburira", "Kugaburira Kugaburira", "Ibimenyetso Bisesengura" na "Indwara Yanduye" biranga uburezi no gutanga amakuru gusa.
• Ibisubizo bya AI bitangwa na algorithms kandi ntabwo bisimbuza inama zamatungo yabigize umwuga, gusuzuma, cyangwa kuvura.
• Umukoresha yemeye kugisha inama veterineri wabiherewe uruhushya mbere yo gufata ibyemezo byose byo kugaburira no kuvura bijyanye n'amatungo.
• Nyiri porogaramu ntabwo agomba kuryozwa igihombo cyamatungo cyangwa ibyangiritse biturutse kumikoreshereze ya porogaramu nibiranga.

emergency_containment_protocol_steps:
1. 🔒 Immediate Quarantine: Seal affected pen immediately; restrict personnel access.
2. 🚫 Movement Freeze: Cease all live pig, pork, feed, and manure shipments off-farm.
3. 🧼 Disinfect: Deploy boot baths & tyre dips with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda.
4. 📞 Mandatory Reporting: Contact your District Veterinary Officer immediately.
5. ⚠️ No Slaughter: Do not slaughter sick or suspect animals for meat.
bio_proto_asf: IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY QUARANTINE: African Swine Fever is a lethal, legally notifiable virus. 1) Lock down farm gates immediately. 2) Stop all movement of pigs, vehicles, feed, and manure. 3) Disinfect all boot baths and tyres with Virkon S or 2% caustic soda. 4) Contact your District/National Veterinary Officer immediately.
bio_proto_fmd: NOTIFIABLE EPIDEMIC ALERT: Foot-and-Mouth Disease spreads rapidly through aerosols and equipment. 1) Quarantine suspect pen immediately. 2) No live pigs or personnel movement off-site. 3) Setup tyre baths and boot dips with approved disinfectant. 4) Notify livestock authorities immediately.
bio_proto_csf: NOTIFIABLE DISEASE ALERT: Classical Swine Fever (Hog Cholera). 1) Restrict pen access and isolate suspect animals. 2) Halt all pig sales and shipments. 3) Wear dedicated boots/overalls. 4) Report to official state veterinary services immediately.
bio_proto_anthrax: DANGER - ZOONOTIC EMERGENCY: Bacillus anthracis can infect humans. 1) DO NOT OPEN CARCASSES (exposure to air causes resistant spores). 2) Isolate surviving pigs. 3) Wear full PPE. 4) Call veterinary authorities for safe incineration or deep burial with quicklime.
bio_proto_pseudorabies: NOTIFIABLE HERPESVIRUS ALERT: Pseudorabies / Aujeszky's causes severe neurological fatality in piglets. 1) Strict pen quarantine. 2) Control wild animals and rodents. 3) Notify state veterinary authorities immediately.
bio_proto_rabies: FATAL ZOONOTIC ALERT: Rabies transmits to humans through saliva and bites. 1) DO NOT HANDLE PIG WITH BARE HANDS. 2) Secure pen tightly. 3) Alert veterinary and public health authorities immediately.
bio_proto_vesicular_stomatitis: REPORTABLE VESICULAR LESION ALERT: Vesicular Stomatitis is clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease. 1) Isolate infected pigs immediately. 2) Wear protective gloves. 3) Report to state veterinarian for lab differential diagnosis.
bio_proto_senecavirus: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Senecavirus A lesions are clinically indistinguishable from Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). 1) Quarantine pen immediately. 2) Restrict off-farm movement. 3) Notify livestock veterinary authorities for mandatory differential PCR testing.
bio_proto_svd: REPORTABLE VESICULAR DISEASE: Swine Vesicular Disease (SVD). 1) Strict isolation of infected animals. 2) Restrict all vehicle and visitor movements. 3) Report to state animal health department immediately.
